TXT_CODE_TERMINAL_HISTORY_LIMIT_DESC: Maximum size of recent logs shown when opening a terminal. Set to 0 to disable history replay. Applies to newly opened terminals.
TXT_CODE_TERMINAL_SCROLLBACK_DESC: Number of history lines available by scrolling up. Set to 0 to disable scrollback. Applies to newly opened terminals.
TXT_CODE_TERMINAL_FONT_FAMILY_DESC: Use locally installed monospace fonts, with fallback fonts separated by commas. Applies to newly opened terminals.
TXT_CODE_TERMINAL_FONT_SIZE_DESC: Terminal text size in pixels. Applies to newly opened terminals.
TXT_CODE_TERMINAL_CTRL_C_PROTECTION_DESC: When enabled, press Ctrl+C twice within the configured interval to send it. When disabled, one press sends it. Applies to newly opened terminals.
TXT_CODE_TERMINAL_CTRL_C_INTERVAL_DESC: Maximum time between two Ctrl+C presses, in milliseconds. Applies to newly opened terminals.
TXT_CODE_TERMINAL_INVALID_SETTINGS: Invalid terminal settings. Check the numeric ranges and font family.
